title: Cardio Q50 ECG monitor: 3D product feature walkthrough (Pexo AI)
summary: An AI-generated 3D product commercial for a medical ECG monitor: the device floats in a pale blue-white studio with volumetric light rays, and every 4.5 s exactly a new feature chapter cuts in (display, workflow, battery, full disclosure, algorithm, HIPAA, printer). Each chapter has a small blue category pill top-left, a bold feature title + small blue subline at bottom-centre, and a slow camera move on the device or into its screen.
fit_reason: Clean clinical light-blue look and the rigid 'category pill + feature title + subline every 4.5 s' template suit B2B feature lists, but it needs 3D renders and feels generic/stock.

palette.mood: light clinical, cool blue-white with soft god rays

typography.display: bold rounded-ish grotesk (Inter/Poppins Bold) for feature titles
typography.size_behaviour: medium title bottom-centre (~4% height) with small blue subline (~1.7%) below; small blue rounded category pill top-left (DISPLAY, WORKFLOW, ENDURANCE, MONITORING, INTELLIGENCE, SECURITY, REPORTING)
typography.notes: Title sits on a soft white gradient band at the bottom for legibility. Corner 'Pexo' watermark bottom-right, 'BIONET' brand top-right.

text_animation: title + subline fade-up together at chapter start
motion: push-in through screen to on-screen UI
scanning light bar sweeps over screen
holographic shield icon builds with check
transitions: zoom-through into screen within a chapter
ui_treatment: rebuilt UI on the device's screen, camera pushes into it

sound.sync: cuts on a fixed 4.5 s grid

signature_moves: rigid 4.5 s chapter grid with category pill + title + subline
single hero product in a bright god-ray studio
camera pushes through the product screen into the UI

best_segments.what: 'Smart AUTO Workflow' chapter: WORKFLOW pill, device, UI changes on screen, title + subline
'HIPAA Compliant' chapter: holographic shield builds with checkmark beside device

recreate.how: Needs 3D renders or AI product video (image-to-video of a product render); overlay template in Remotion: pill top-left, gradient band + title/subline bottom, 4.5 s chapter grid. For SaaS, swap device for a floating laptop/browser mockup.
recreate.prompt: Bright clinical studio, pale blue-white with soft light rays, a single product floating and slowly orbiting, every 4.5 s a new feature chapter: small blue category pill top-left, bold title and small blue subline bottom-centre, camera pushes into the screen UI.
